mapper.select: select dm.id, dm.um, su.name as employeeName, sd.name as departmentName, md.device_name as deviceName, md.device_status as deviceStatus, dm.wx_header_pic as wxHeaderPic, dm.wx_nick_name as wxNickName, dm.wx_account as wxAccount, dm.last_sync_time as lastSyncTime, dm.update_time as updateTime from mmba_device_mapping dm left join sys_user su on su.um = dm.um left join sys_organization_user sou on sou.organization_id = #{orgId} and sou.user_id = su.id left join sys_department sd on sd.id = sou.department_id left join mmba_device md on md.id = ( select d1.id from mmba_device d1 where d1.um = dm.um order by case when d1.device_status = 1 then 0 else 1 end, d1.update_time desc limit 1 ) where sou.id is not null order by ifnull(dm.last_sync_time, dm.update_time) desc, dm.update_time desc
